items.title: Gambia Immigration Department Intercepts 62 Suspected Irregular Migrants in Tanji and Brufut Ghana Town
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh The Gambia Immigration Department (GID) has intercepted 62 suspected irregular migrants, including six minors, during a joint operation in Tanji and Brufut Ghana Town on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. According to a statement issued by the department, the operat...
